text:
ryan: AcmeMaps ping — customer reports p95/p99 spikes for chat generate in us-west1 starting ~00:10 UTC. Latency up ~3-4x after last night's runtime rollout.

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-342 created (channel: eng-runtime)

maria: I pulled traces: kernel_selector chose sdpa_v2 for acme-chat-v2 at ~512 tokens; previously it picked flashattn. SDPA path is slower on medium/variable sequences.

jonah: Paste a sample request and trace id so I can repro locally.

maria: Repro steps — quick local curl loop:
``
for i in {1..50}; do \
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
    -d '{"model":"acme-chat-v2","input":"summarize: lorem ipsum ... (var len 400-600)"}' &
done
```
Trace snippet (prod request x-zz-112233):
```
kernel_select: sdpa_v2 -> latency 78ms
kv_cache_fetch: 12ms
token_gen: 190ms (sdpa hotpath)
```
Reference before rollout:
```
kernel_select: flashattn_v1 -> latency 45ms
token_gen: 70ms (flash hotpath)
```

deepa (eng-runtime): That's ~2.7x regression on token_gen — matches customer report. Rollout 3221 enabled SDPA compile flag (optimize-sdpa=true). I can toggle fallback.

jonah: Mitigations:
- revert compile flag globally (optimize-sdpa=false)
- per-model kernel blacklist to force flashattn for acme-chat-v2
- enable kernel hysteresis to prevent mid-session flips

maria: Doing non-disruptive per-model toggle: add kernel_blacklist: ["sdpa_v2"] for acme-chat-v2 and restart a subset of workers in us-west1.

maria: Applying patch:
```
PATCH /runtime/configs/acme-chat-v2
{ "kernel_blacklist": ["sdpa_v2"] }
```

deploy-bot: rolling restart 4/12 workers in us-west1 (group: acme-model-nodes)

support-bot: Notified customer: "We pinned kernel selection for your model; monitoring p95/p99. ETA ~10-15m."

lee (eng-sre): Creating short-lived alert: if p95 > 1.5x baseline then page.

maria: Spot-check after restart:
- before: p95 ~180ms, p99 ~320ms
- after: p95 ~72ms, p99 ~95ms

jonah: Can we update kernel heuristic to prefer flash when median seq length 256-1024 and KV hit rate >0.6? Cost model currently favors SDPA on token/op metric.

deepa: I'll open PR to kernel-heuristics with seq-length weighting and perf tests; gate behind rollout flag. ETA ~6h.

maria: Canary plan for rollout fixes:
1) per-model blacklist for impacted customers (done)
2) roll back optimize-sdpa flag from rollout 3221 if canary shows regressions (rollback window 02:30 UTC)
3) ship heuristic change gated behind rollout

sara-cs: Updated AcmeMaps with rollback and heuristic timeline; they want to be notified when global revert is scheduled.

jonah: Action items:
- deepa: PR + benchmarks (owner)
- maria: monitor p95/p99 for 1h and report
- lee: keep alerts on for 6h
- sara-cs: customer comms

maria: 25m post-mitigation: p95/p99 stable and at baseline for their traffic. Will validate 1h then close incident.

sara-cs: Customer confirmed and thanks team :thumbsup:

maria: Recommend adding rollout invariant: if p95 for top-10 customers increases >1.4x during rollout, auto-pause. I'll file a follow-up.

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-342 status -> monitoring (updated)

james: Adding auto-pause criterion to rollout controller RFC; will ping when ready.

maria: Thanks all — good cross-team response.
